content_sections.heading: NIFTEM JRF Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: JRF : M.Sc./ M.Tech in Chemistry/ Analytical Chemistry/ Organic Chemistry/ Natural Products Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Food Technology/ Food Science & Nutrition/ Microbiology OR Bachelor’s Degree in Science (B.Sc.)/ B. Tech/ B.E. in Food Technology/ Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology. Minimum 06 months of relevant experience for M.Sc/ M.Tech or minimum 2 years for Bachelor's degree in food testing, food analysis, laboratory operations, and quality control.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM JRF Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: JRF : Maximum age is 35 years. Age relaxations apply as per Government of India rules: 5 years for Women, SC, ST, OBC, and Differently Abled candidates. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIFTEM JRF Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIFTEM to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management (NIFTEM), Kundli, Sonepat, Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NIFTEM?
faq.answer: NIFTEM has advertised for the JRF (Quality Assurance Executive) post under a project-based engagement in research.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the JRF (Quality Assurance Executive) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for NIFTEM JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely online through the official portal.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./M.Tech in relevant disciplines like Chemistry, Biotechnology, Food Technology, Microbiology, or a Bachelor's degree (B.Sc./B.Tech/B.E.) with requisite experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the JRF (Quality Assurance Executive) post will receive a monthly salary of ₹37,000 plus 8% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories and women as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIFTEM JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the short-listing of candidates based on qualifications followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment portal at http://career.droniftem.com before the final deadline.
